test/helpers/pty/runners/floor.ts.nonBehavioral: The PTY floor and observation runners end a plan-mode turn at an idle prompt (the plan-mode footer without its running 'esc to interrupt' segment, after a 10 s settle) instead of waiting out the deadline. The floor runner exits as api_error only after the idle screen with its error panel held still for 10 s and every tick's question and assessment steps found nothing to credit (the transcript is re-read each tick), so a native or prose question already on screen is credited as before, even when its transcript line lands after the screen draws done (test/helpers/claude-pty-runner.runners.unit.test.ts, the prose-question-before-panel case). With no qualifying question an idle turn stays idle, so a trial that failed at the deadline as observer_timeout now fails earlier as api_error. An observation returns what the deadline would have returned. A running footer, extra footer text and a cut footer still wait for the deadline. No pass becomes a fail or a fail a pass. The session ledger may now record failure_cause api_error or refusal instead of observer_timeout or session_timeout for a plan-mode session whose last idle turn shows a panel; failure_class, the gate red class and pass rates are unchanged, so no pass-rate series resets
